Caveats (not fixed, not affecting this answer): 3 rows have negative Quantity (e.g. rows 1 and 34), which violates the rules (Quantity ≥ 1) and makes their Revenue negative. These rows were kept because Price itself is valid, but they should be reviewed before any quantity/revenue analysis. Region has 2 missing values and some spacing variants, which also don't affect this question.
